risks.title: Automatic Renewal Trap with Strict Notice Requirements
risks.original_clause:
3. Term and Termination
This Agreement shall remain in effect for a term of three (3) years from the Effective Date. Either party may terminate upon thirty (30) days written notice.
risks.explanation: The agreement renews automatically for multi-year commitments unless cancelled within an expansive advance notice window via restrictive delivery channels.
risks.why_it_matters: Missing a narrow administrative deadline locks your organization into prolonged multi-year contractual and financial commitments involuntarily.
risks.possible_consequences: Unwanted continuation of vendor fees and legal duties without convenient exit opportunities.
suggested_questions: Can the renewal notice window be reduced to a standard 30 or 60 days?
Can electronic written notice by email be permitted instead of strictly certified postal mail?
risks.evidence_quote:
Term and Termination
This Agreement shall remain in effect for a term of three (3) years from the Effective Date.

risks.title: Extended Confidentiality Obligation
risks.original_clause:
3. Term and Termination
This Agreement shall remain in effect for a term of three (3) years from the Effective Date. Either party may terminate upon thirty (30) days written notice.
risks.explanation: Confidentiality obligations persist for an extended multi-year duration of three years.
risks.why_it_matters: The receiving party must maintain information security safeguards for several years following disclosure.
risks.possible_consequences: Ongoing compliance duties and liability exposure for accidental disclosures across three years.
suggested_questions: Can the confidentiality duration be reduced from 3 years to 1 or 2 years?
Can standard public domain and independent development carve-outs be explicitly confirmed?

summary.summary_detailed:
NON-DISCLOSURE AND CONFIDENTIALITY AGREEMENT
This Agreement is entered into on January 15, 2026, between Acme Corporation ("Disclosing Party") and Beta Labs LLC ("Receiving Party").

Definitions
"Confidential Information" includes all technical, business, and financial information disclosed by Disclosing Party to Receiving Party, whether orally or in writing.

Non-Disclosure Obligations
Receiving Party shall hold and maintain the Confidential Information in strictest confidence.

Receiving Party shall not disclose any Confidential Information to third parties without prior written consent.

Term and Termination
This Agreement shall remain in effect for a term of three (3) years from the Effective Date.

Either party may terminate upon thirty (30) days written notice.

Governing Law and Jurisdiction
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to conflict of law principles.
